# adapter-ingestion

> Scheduled ingestion of JSON APIs, CSV files, RSS and Atom feeds and HTML pages into a local JSONL store, with change detection, a read-time relevance filter, and a canary that flags a source that changed shape or went quiet.

npm package `@shrinivas-sn/adapter-ingestion`: plain JavaScript (ES modules) with no runtime dependencies, Node 22.15 or newer. Each source is a JSON adapter checked by `validateAdapter` and `schema/adapter.schema.json`. Every run writes a report (`report_version` 2) with an `outcome`, a canary verdict and `notices` (advice `A_*`, deprecations `D_*`). The `adapter-ingestion` CLI has `validate`, `run`, `explain` and `doctor`, each with `--json`. Agents should start with AGENTS.md.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/shrinivas-sn/adapter-ingestion/blob/main/AGENTS.md): task recipes for coding agents and the full code table
- [README](https://github.com/shrinivas-sn/adapter-ingestion/blob/main/README.md): API, adapter key reference, source kinds, run report reference, gotchas
- [Adapter JSON Schema](https://github.com/shrinivas-sn/adapter-ingestion/blob/main/schema/adapter.schema.json): every adapter key with a description
- [VERSIONING.md](https://github.com/shrinivas-sn/adapter-ingestion/blob/main/VERSIONING.md): what each release may change; deprecation policy
- [UPGRADING.md](https://github.com/shrinivas-sn/adapter-ingestion/blob/main/UPGRADING.md): what each minor version adds, and what to change
